The Club At Falcon Point is a very well managed and operated club / "Clubhouse" with amenities.
I endorse everything about this Club except that they do not let members or the children fish from their ponds full of Texas Sized Bass.
It's no secret that many members as well as residents in the neighborhood occasionally fish there, with respect for club members, knowing not to go anywhere near an area that they could impede a golfer, or present safety issues.
If / when I've been asked to leave by a Club Employee of Member they have always been respectful and courteous, and complying with their "Request" is the right thing to do.
If the Club At Falcon Point created a recreational Catch and Release Fishing program for members and guest, they could manage safe areas for fishing, as well as protocol, such as when and where, how much $$$ for a Day Pass, or how much for a Fishing only membership annually.
There is no telling how much additional revenue this would create. The only question would be how many would be allowed, and then the rest would be on a lengthy waiting list of Anglers wanting to join solely for fishing.
This club has a Nice Golf Course, and some of The Best Bass Fishing from the Shore in Texas. Why this hasn't been monetized I can only guess....
Sir Winston Churchill said it best, "Change is the Cost of Survival". I concur.
NOTE: All Bass Pictured were caught and released.
